request: Run both bundled Detection Quality fixture suites from one plain-language request, verify the gaps and resume interrupted work.
scope: The local Detection Quality workbench, its registered skill and their synthetic fixture inputs.
setup: Use the repository Python environment with the project test and runtime dependencies installed. Run commands from the repository root.
constraints: Use a dedicated worktree. Do not change shared routing policy or invoke unrelated workbenches. Store only local pilot state and validate it before reuse.

steps.action: Add an explicit bundled-review route for the public ask and advisory route entry points.

verify.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_detection_quality_pilot.py -k route
verify.expected: The workbench and skill agree across both commands.

steps.action: Evaluate the two fixture suites with their published evaluator, validate their reports and checkpoint completion for restart.

verify.expected: The success, routing boundaries, recovery and integrity cases pass.

steps.action: Specify the user-facing behavior and document the CLI, trust boundary, and follow-on coordinator issues.

verify.expected: The public command runs both fixtures and reports their gaps.

acceptance.given: A user asks for the bundled Detection Quality pilot.
acceptance.when: Submit the request and inspect its result.
acceptance.then: Both suites have verified receipts and the report identifies the three telemetry gaps.

acceptance.given: The first suite is saved and the process exits during dispatch of the second.
acceptance.when: Resume the run concurrently and then reopen the verified run.
acceptance.then: The already accepted suite is reused and each evaluator executes exactly once in this interruption scenario.

acceptance.given: The user asks for a different, ambiguous or unsupported task.
acceptance.when: Submit the request with a new run directory.
acceptance.then: No pilot is executed or checkpoint created.

acceptance.given: The request explicitly names the bundled fixture review.
acceptance.when: Preview the route then run the request.
acceptance.then: The preview and actual owner agree.
